guidance: So basically, when you say that we are on target for our capex this year, which is about INR9,000 crores, what we have targeted, right?
Can you share the similar guidance for '28 and '29 as well?
capex: I would like to clarify that the utilization percentages for the current and previous quarters are based on Dahej's expanded capacity of 22.5 million ton per annum compared to 17.5 million metric ton per annum last year.
Coming to capacity utilization, Dahej operated at 73% compared with 66% in the previous quarter and 92% in the corresponding quarter.
focus: And in addition to this, the new players who are entering the market or the ambition to enter the market, they are also in discussions to tie-up capacity.
And definitely, we have had some discussion with Qatar to diversify supply under the renewed contract, which will start in 2028.
